annotations.title: Find published controls about one concern

description: Which published security controls cover this? Give one of six concerns -- encryption at rest, audit logging, session timeout, key rotation, access review, backup -- and get the NIST SP 800-53 and HIPAA Security Rule provisions whose own text speaks to it, each with its citation and the publisher's verbatim sentence. The match is a literal phrase search over the published text, and every result names the phrase it matched and where it matched (control title or requirement text), so the selection can be checked rather than trusted. This is a search over what the publishers wrote, not an opinion about what your system needs.

concern.description: One of the six concerns listed.

framework.description: Optional. Limit the answer to one document: "nist" for NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, "hipaa" for the HIPAA Security Rule.
